persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a 10-second widescreen water-cycle explainer with a friendly voice-over you write. Show water rising, clouds forming, then rain. Label those stages exactly “Evaporation”, “Condensation”, and “Precipitation”, in that order. No other on-screen text.
bank.Exact on-screen labels: Evaporation; Condensation; Precipitation. Use that capitalization and order, without quotation marks.
bank.Other text: No other on-screen text, including subtitles.
bank.Voice and language: Friendly English voice; specific voice is your call.

messages.text: Could you make a water-cycle explainer with a friendly voice-over that you write? I always find this process easier to understand when I can actually watch it happen. What I mean is, show water rising, then clouds forming, then rain, and make it 10 seconds long in widescreen. For those stages, use the exact labels “Evaporation”, “Condensation”, and “Precipitation”, in that order. I’m probably over-explaining because I worry about getting the stages mixed up. Please don’t put any other text on screen.
